text:
emma_cs: Morning — quick async standup re: OrbitHealth renewal. Renewal in 2 weeks; they reported higher embedding latency and a feed ingestion mismatch. What I did: filed support ticket #523, captured logs, escalated to eng. Blockers: embeddings timeout causing failed suggestions in UI; Renewal risk if not resolved. Today: need eng triage + ETA for fix, and a short customer note. Logs pasted below.

mike_eng: saw the ticket, looking now. Can you paste the exact failure trace? Also what's the traffic % failing vs success? @samir_sre FYI.

emma_cs: pasted error: ```ERROR 2026-03-01T10:12:34Z embedding_request failed: context DeadlineExceeded: after 2m``` Traffic roughly 8% of inference calls, spikes during mornings. Also their dataset has many long docs (>4k tokens).

mike_eng: ok looks like kv-cache eviction + long-context causing slower forward pass. I can do a patch to increase request timeout and add chunking. Will open PR today. ETA EOD for PR, tomorrow for canary.

lena_pm: small ask — customer wants a short note on workaround (reduce batch size + retry). Can we provide wording they can use in their support portal?

samir_sre: I can add a temporary routing rule to move OrbitHealth requests to larger GPU pool during morning window to buy time. Need approval from finance for burst cost, but should be cheap for 2 weeks. @emma_cs can you confirm window (08:00-11:00 PDT)?

emma_cs: confirmed 08:00-11:00 PDT. Please proceed with routing if finance approves. Also, they're asking about SLA credit if this persists — we should avoid that. :grimacing: 

mike_eng: opening PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/pull/8421 — includes timeout bump + chunking. Will request review from @lena_pm for impact note. Can someone run canary tomorrow morning?

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2026-03-02T08:00Z on pool 'm-gpu-large' — will auto-roll back on error > 1%.

lena_pm: I'll review the PR and draft the customer note. Emma, I'll post the note here for sign-off before sending.

emma_cs: thanks team. Blocker = eng PR + canary + routing approval. I'll loop in finance. Ping me in thread if you need access to OrbitHealth tenant data
